notes: Partition checked: 11 source morphemes, 10 target tokens, each used once.

*made war* is split between עָשָׂה and מִלְחָמָה, each of which holds an English word of its own (rule 2); rule 44's light-verb reading governs one Hebrew verb, not a verb with a written cognate object.
יָמִים רַבִּים is an adverbial accusative of duration: the supplied *a* joins the noun and the unit is discontinuous around the adjective (rules 15, 25, 33).
s005 אֶת is the preposition H854 *with*, not the object marker (rule 16).
